# Inside the Smile

> An interactive visual narrative exploring internal thoughts, emotional burnout, and the power of reaching out for mental health support.

Inside the Smile is an interactive, scroll-driven web experience depicting the daily pressure of hiding anxiety behind a smile and the transformative moment of connection.

## Interactive Story Chapters

- [Chapter 00: The Smile](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#00): CRT monitor power-on sequence and entry gate into the story.
- [Chapter 01: The Distraction](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#01): Late-night workstation scene depicting endless work and avoidance.
- [Chapter 02: The Message](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#02): A smartphone conversation contrasting external performance with internal reality.
- [Chapter 03: The Noise](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#03): 3D floating thought cloud and racing internal monologue.
- [Chapter 04: The Weight](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#04): Generative ASCII art visualization of anxiety and mental weight.
- [Chapter 05: The Reach](https://inside-the-smile.vercel.app/#05): The climactic touch of two reaching hands, restoring warmth and hope.

## Support & Crisis Resources

- [988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline](https://988lifeline.org/): Free, confidential 24/7 support in the US and Canada (Call or text 988).
- [Crisis Text Line](https://www.crisistextline.org/): Free 24/7 mental health text support (Text HOME to 741741).
- [The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/): Crisis intervention and suicide prevention for LGBTQ young people (1-866-488-7386).
- [Befrienders Worldwide](https://www.befrienders.org/): Global network of crisis helplines and emotional support centers.
